questionReadAloudEn: What is a system of equations?

Two related equations that have the
same variables and must be solved
together
 Ex: C + B = 55
 B = 2C - 41

questionReadAloudEn:

●​ Since the 2nd equation says, B equals 2C - 41
●​ You can replace the “B” in the first
 equation with “2C – 41”
Now you can solve:
 C + 2C - 41 = 55

What did Pythagoras figure out
about every right triangle in the
world? (i.e. The Pythagorean Theorem)
answerReadAloudEn:
For every right triangle in the world:
●​ if you draw squares on all the sides
●​ the areas of the
 2 smaller squares
●​ always add up
 to the area of the
 biggest square.
